name: Yanagida Masami
source: A first-year student who is uncomfortable with it being mandatory for her to wear a skirt, leading her to ask the student council for help. Finds feminine clothing to be unpleasant in general. Well-behaved and does not want to cause trouble, but finds it hard to trust the teachers and the student council members.
